answer_1.quote: We design a probing methodology consisting of four techniques: forced closed-style, forced reverse order, forced open-ended, and fully unconstrained to evaluate the cultural alignment of LLMs across varying levels of constraints.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include model responses to culturally grounded survey questions under varying probing constraints (closed-style, reverse order, open-ended, unconstrained), which are then evaluated for cultural alignment.

answer_2.quote: Following AlKhamissi et al. (2024), we employ two metrics for evaluating WVS responses. The first is the Hard Alignment Metric, which measures plain accuracy... The second metric is the Soft Alignment Metric, a relaxed version of the hard metric that assigns partial credit for ordinal-scale and categorical questions.

answer_4.quote: The first two authors manually reviewed a random sample of 100 forced open-ended and 100 fully unconstrained responses, comparing extracted stances with the model-generated ones.
